description: This file defines an interface `IAppLogger<T>` that abstracts logging functionalities, eliminating the dependency on ASP.NET Core specific logging types. It provides methods for logging informational and warning messages with optional parameters.

classes.name: IAppLogger<T>
classes.description: An interface for application logging that can be used across different parts of the application, allowing for dependency injection and easier testing.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs an informational message with optional additional arguments.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with optional additional arguments.
